### EESC 222 / 422: Environmental Remote Sensing

A course for juniors, seniors and graduate students, organized around phenomena instead of sensors. It moves from radiative foundations through ecology, atmosphere and ocean applications to a capstone project. Labs use Python and Google Earth Engine.
:::

Before Rochester I taught mathematics and supervised undergraduate and graduate research projects.
